question: Can deterministic policy screening recover two independently held-out Duskblade v5 endpoints for each admitted mediator without changing v8 content?

researchCohorts.validation: selected frozen policies, seeds 129000-129063, Duskblade vow 5

competingOptions.statement: Fresh deterministic screening identifies route-grounded policies that retain both Dusk endpoints on independent seeds.
Screened route policies do not retain two held-out C2-viable endpoints under the exact candidate.

estimands.screen: For each Dusk package, rank policies that acquire and activate the mediator by four-seed wins, then target activation and policy index; freeze eight per route.
estimands.heldoutViability: Each route retains at least two selected policies whose 64-seed win rate exceeds held-out RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35.
estimands.heldoutActivation: Every credited selected policy applies and consumes its route mediator on held-out seeds.
estimands.retention: Both route best-policy rates remain within 0.10 and credited policy sets differ.
estimands.reliability: Paired candidate-minus-live added stalls on the selected policy rectangle; any added stall or simulator error fails.
estimands.vow5: Every selected-policy held-out win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule.screen: Eight distinct policies per Dusk route are frozen without simulator faults.
successRule.heldoutViability: At least two policies per route meet activation and the 0.35 C2 margin.
successRule.retention: Both route endpoints are within 0.10 and use distinct credited policy sets.
successRule.reliability: No candidate-added stall and zero candidate/live simulator errors.
successRule.vow5: All selected-policy held-out win rates are at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Screen 512 policies on four fresh Duskblade-v5 seeds, freeze eight per route, then evaluate only that frozen repertoire on 64 independent paired candidate/live seeds.
inconclusiveRule: The held-out 64-seed rectangle is final for this repertoire. No top-up, reselection or content change is allowed inside v9.
stopRule: Reject on an incomplete screen, fewer than two held-out viable policies per route, endpoint collapse, a candidate-added stall, simulator error or Vow-5 ceiling breach. Detector mutations remain forbidden until the repertoire passes.
